task.description: WF-02 Step 2 (implementation) for REQ-035 on branch feature/WF02-REQ-035, implementing docs/agents/design/REQ-035.md exactly (design gate PASSED clean at step-01b, no issues). Implemented every design element: (1) domain/registration.ts -- PendingRequestListItem + listPendingRequestsForOrganizer (S3-safe: profiles.phone/email structurally absent from the select clause, mirrors listAdmittedRegistrantsForCheckin), getPendingRequestForOrganizer (single-row read for the detail view, same S3-safe shape, returns null when the row is not 'requested'), decideApprovalOutcome (pure, first-match-wins, structural copy of decideWalkinOutcome's override-threading table narrowed to approve/approve-override/needs-override-confirmation), approveRequest (SELECT...FOR UPDATE on the registration row THEN the events row, fresh in-tx countAdmittedRegistrations re-read, decide, conditional UPDATE admission='admitted'+qrToken via the EXISTING generateQrToken() -- never a second generator -- distinct audit actions registration.approve vs registration.approve_override), decideRejectionOutcome + rejectRequest (SELECT...FOR UPDATE, decide, conditional UPDATE admission='rejected', one audit_log row action registration.reject with the reason in payload -- registrations.noShowReason is never touched, per design Open Question 1). (2) i18n: added the organizerRequests catalog section to types.ts/en.ts/ru.ts (placeholder copy per decisions/0002) -- the reject notification's onward path reuses catalog.event.deepLinkSeeUpcoming UNCHANGED, no new key for it, per the design's zero-Wishlist decision. (3) handlers/organizerRequests.ts (new file): /requests <event_id> [query] list command (requireOrganizerForChapter checked on the handler before any list read, S2), req:page pagination reusing PAGE_SIZE/SEARCH_RESULT_LIMIT imported from handlers/checkin.ts (Open Question 2 resolved: import as-is), req:open detail view (re-runs S2, renders company/position/student/source, never phone/email), req:approve + req:approve_confirm + req:approve_cancel (the override-confirmation sub-flow -- Cancel performs NO domain call at all, so AC4's 'dismissing leaves admission=requested unchanged' holds by construction), req:reject prompting a reason via force_reply + a fixed 'Reject ref: <id>' line (mirrors handlers/noShow.ts's exact ref-line + generic reply-to-message-text-listener mechanism, Open Question 5 resolved), with the listener re-running requireOrganizerForChapter before writing (S2 -- the text reply is itself the write-triggering action, not only the preceding button tap). Both notifications sent via the EXISTING sendLedgeredNotification with kind:'admission_result', classification:'transactional' (S10) -- no new NotificationKind literal. (4) index.ts wiring for the new command/callbacks/listener, ordered after every bot.command(...) registration per this file's own established discipline. Every requireOrganizerForChapter call resolves against the REGISTRATION's OWN event's chapterId (AC7), never the caller's own chapter; EventStaff is never consulted (AC6, traced in the design and unchanged here). No schema/migration change anywhere -- confirmed by grep (see result.summary). Ran the real checks synchronously: npm run lint -w apps/bot (clean), npm run build -w apps/bot (clean tsc), and npx vitest run --no-file-parallelism (343/343 existing tests pass, no regressions). No new automated tests were written in this step -- REQ-035's own AC5 (20+-repeat real-Postgres concurrency test) and the rest of the AC-to-test mapping is TEST-DESIGNER's Step 3 scope, per this project's WF-02 pipeline; this step's own required checks (lint/build/existing-suite) all passed.
acceptance_criteria: Approving sets admission='admitted', issues a non-null qr_token via the existing generateQrToken(), and notifies the person.
Rejecting sets admission='rejected', notifies, and the captured message contains BOTH the organizer's stated reason AND an onward path pointing at the upcoming-events list.
No wishlist table, migration or row is created by this requirement, verified by grepping every migration and the schema for 'wishlist'.

Approving when admitted count already equals capacity requires an explicit confirmation: dismissing leaves admission='requested' unchanged; confirming sets 'admitted' AND writes exactly one audit_log row recording the override.

Two organizers approving the last remaining seat concurrently never produce an admitted count above capacity without an override -- verified by an automated concurrency test, 20+ repeats, real Postgres.
A member, and separately an EventStaff member for that same event, each invoking the approve handler DIRECTLY are both refused and the registration is unchanged.
An organizer of chapter A invoking the approve handler for a chapter B event is refused.
The rendered request list contains no phone number and no email address.
The approval and the rejection notification each reach a user with broadcast_opt_in=false.
Each approve and each reject writes exactly one audit_log row.

result.summary: Implemented docs/agents/design/REQ-035.md exactly, with no invented business rules. Files changed: apps/bot/src/domain/registration.ts (added countAdmittedRegistrations import from event.js, plus PendingRequestListItem/listPendingRequestsForOrganizer/getPendingRequestForOrganizer/ApprovalDecisionInput/ApprovalOutcome/decideApprovalOutcome/ApproveRequestResult/approveRequest/RejectionDecisionInput/RejectionOutcome/decideRejectionOutcome/rejectRequest -- all new exports, no existing export modified), apps/bot/src/handlers/organizerRequests.ts (new file, ~470 lines: list/detail/pagination/approve/override-confirm/override-cancel/reject callbacks plus the reject text-reply listener), apps/bot/src/i18n/{types,en,ru}.ts (new organizerRequests catalog section, placeholder copy per decisions/0002), apps/bot/src/index.ts (command + 6 callback-pattern registrations + 1 message:text listener, wired after every existing bot.command(...) registration). No schema/migration file touched; grepped apps/bot/src and apps/bot for 'wishlist' (case-insensitive) -- the only hit is a code comment in organizerRequests.ts citing the design's own 'zero Wishlist' decision (§0.4/§5), not an entity/table/column/row (AC3 verified). No second QR-token generator introduced -- approveRequest calls the existing generateQrToken() (registration.ts line ~90), confirmed by reading the call site. overrideAdmitAndCheckIn (REQ-029) was NOT reused or modified, per the design's own traced distinction and the task's explicit constraint. Checks run synchronously, real output: `npm run lint -w apps/bot` -> clean (eslint ., no output, exit 0). `npm run build -w apps/bot` -> clean (tsc -p tsconfig.json, no output, exit 0). `npx vitest run --no-file-parallelism` -> 'Test Files 37 passed (37)', 'Tests 343 passed (343)', 53.60s -- full existing suite green, zero regressions. Working tree verified clean via `git status --short` after the commit (ISS-0030): no output after `git commit`, `git status --short` showed nothing.
issues: PLUMBING NOTE (design Open Question 2, resolved): /requests <event_id> [query] takes the search query as a second command-line argument, the identical first-token-plus-remainder shape handlers/checkin.ts's /checkin already uses -- the design's own §6.1 prose says the search query 'arrives via a callback flow, not the initial command', but names no concrete callback/button for triggering it and explicitly frames the exact mechanism as BACKEND-DEV's plumbing choice with 'no behavioral consequence either way'. Chose the already-built, already-tested command-argument shape over inventing an unspecified callback UI. Flagging this literal wording deviation transparently for REVIEWER's own judgment call, per backend-dev.md's 'do not invent business rules' discipline -- this is a plumbing/UI-mechanism choice, not a business rule, but is called out rather than silently resolved.

SCOPE NOTE: no automated tests were added in this step. TEST-DESIGNER (WF-02 Step 3) owns writing the verification suite against all 10 ACs, including AC5's mandated 20+-repeat real-Postgres concurrency test -- this step's own obligation (lint/build/existing-suite) is complete and green.
